title: R' Ila son of Rav Shmuel bar Marta

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.13b.21): Ila said in the name of Rav.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rabbi Ila son of Rav Shmuel bar Marta teaching in Rav’s name about reciting the first verse of the Shema before falling asleep. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=417&lang=en) records the same chain.
